course_path.heading: Where This Training Fits in Your Team's Learning Path.
course_path.text: Teams start with Fundamentals of Data Warehousing Corporate Training for the core ideas of warehouse design, dimensional modeling and star schemas. ETL Testing Corporate Training then puts those ideas to work on the team's own pipelines, from planning tests off the mapping document to reconciling loads, logging data defects and validating a cloud migration. From there, teams turn their checks into agreed data contracts and quality engineering, and keep the pipelines reliable in production with DataOps.

steps.name: Fundamentals of Data Warehousing Corporate Training

steps.name: Data Contracts and Data Quality Engineering Corporate Training
steps.text: Turn the team's checks into versioned data contracts and quality gates on every pipeline.

steps.name: DataOps and Pipeline Reliability Corporate Training
steps.text: Run the tests in CI/CD, wire lineage, metrics and alerts, and recover from pipeline incidents.
